prediction-mode.name: Prediction Mode
prediction-mode.description:
<cy>Display Frame</c>: predicts where the player will be when the frame is shown (up to one frame ahead, works at any FPS).
<cy>Physics Step</c>: only predicts up to one physics step (1/240s) ahead, the pre-2.4.1 behavior.

wine-cbf-workaround.name: Wine CBF Workaround
wine-cbf-workaround.description: Read the input CBF's Linux helper captures (its Wine workaround path) so early clicks show in the frame being drawn. Requires Click Between Frames v1.5.0.
